comment: Sheet 21 shows four transformer pads labeled as 'Electrical Transformer Pad' but provides NO dimensions specifying pad size (length × width × depth). The requirement mandates that transformer pad dimensions match Austin Energy Design-approved transformer pad detail sheets for the specified service type (single-phase or three-phase). No pad dimensions are provided on the plans, and no reference to Austin Energy Design detail sheets or service type specifications is documented. This is a critical omission.

Transformer Pad 1 is located in the northwest area of the site, immediately adjacent to the main entrance driveway (which provides access to parking and vehicle circulation). Visual analysis using the 1"=20' scale indicates the pad is positioned approximately 2-5 feet from the driveway curb edge. The requirement mandates that equipment pads installed within 4 feet of parking areas or vehicle routes must have 4-inch minimum diameter galvanized rigid metal posts (bollards) per AE Design equipment pad details. Bollards ARE shown on the site plan at other locations (east side, near Buildings 4-5 and 7), but NO bollards are shown around Transformer Pad 1 despite its proximity to the main vehicle entrance/circulation driveway within the 4-foot threshold.
